title: Adventures in Tech with Alana Karen: Fireside Chat + Q&A
desc: Join Alana Karen, former Google leader and author of The Adventures of Women in Tech: Navigating the Hard Tech Era, for a candid fireside chat exploring lessons learned throughout her career. Gain fresh perspectives on navigating change, building a sustainable career, and finding opportunities in today's evolving tech landscape. Bring your questions! Free and open to all!
